budgets.cohort_use: Noise panels use fixed ascending subsets of the same stage-specific clean cohort; clean subset statistics must be recomputed for paired noise contrasts. No additional distinct evaluation seeds. Shared seeds across conditions are intentional pairing, not adaptive cohort reuse.

pilot.clean_gate: Clean rows are counted anew under the same registered sampler/loop as perturbations. Do not reuse older global/batched-sampler rows as an exact control for a new per-game sampler.

budgets.ranking: Noise panels descriptive unless selection/stop thresholds prospectively registered before opening games. Clean P5 Q1/Mean progress/stop criteria unchanged; no posthoc noise gate.
budgets.semantics: Additional proposed hard ceilings, not measured forecasts or authority. Old P4/P5 JSON and caps stay unchanged. New supplement requires source/review/resource/lease gates and explicit approval. Same6GiB separate RSS/MPS and one MPS job.

entropy.distributions: Record original teacher categorical probabilities and post-shield renormalized target probabilities separately, with masks/fallback provenance. Specify which is distilled; no oracle sharpening or best-future-action one-hot labels.
entropy.inference: Entropy is not calibration. No target entropy, distillation benefit or ranking inferred without measurements. No actual student training in this proposal.
entropy.schedules: Keep constant0.01, constant0.001 and registered0.01-to0.001 alternatives. Evaluate survival, noise robustness and soft-label quality together; lower entropy/jitter is not automatically better and uniform labels are not automatically useful.
entropy.weighting: Report per-episode averages plus pooled state counts; compare schedules on a fixed registered admitted-state bank from allowed trajectories as well as own rollouts, to separate occupancy shifts. Preserve target zeros/float precision and temperature1; any smoothing/temperature change is a separate registered intervention.

execution.clean_selector: sampled categorical at temperature1; K1 common primary, actual deployment K separately frozen
execution.delay: Policy observes at its normal decision times. Queue intended actions for execution after exactly d raw frames; hold the prior applied action until due. Start each episode neutral with empty queue; discard its pending actions on termination/reset. No hidden future correction or dropped intermediate action. Raw-frame stepping/queue parity must be implemented first.
execution.epsilon: At each policy-decision boundary, independently replace the intended movement action with a uniform draw over all9 actions with probability epsilon. A draw can equal the intended action; report actual changed-action fraction separately.
execution.frequency: Epsilon is per decision, so K1/K4 perturbation rates per game-second differ. Report decisions, raw frames, realized perturbations and delays; no equal-noise-dose claim across K.
execution.no_combinations: Epsilon and delay conditions separate; no implicit Cartesian combination or tuning on exposed cohorts.
execution.pairing: Counter-based domain-separated policy and perturbation streams per(game seed, decision ordinal, condition); independent of vector slot and episode completion order. Share coupling across models. Noise RNG is external executor randomness, never native-world RNG or a policy input.
execution.zero_noise: epsilon0/delay0 must preserve baseline actions, RNG use and counters; deterministic tests before any approved games.

expected: Epsilon actions and delay may reveal compounding-error sensitivity; the direction and relative ordering of policies/schedules are unobserved. An observation-only expert may be weaker than FullState, which cannot justify relaxing the information boundary.

provenance.allowed_derivations: Geometry/rays/grids/relative-closing velocity and finite action history from admitted entities, measured motion and registered public physics only. No complete-world queries or hidden index tracking.
provenance.critic: Same admitted boundary as actor while value is a distillation target; no privileged critic via encoder separation.
provenance.eligibility: Original FullState AABB remains a disclosed richer-information reference only. Shield/labeler/imitation require a separately reviewed pure-observation expert and its own accepted evaluation.
future_gates: Dependency allowlist: pure arrays/history/constants; no FullState/native-future/RNG access
Identical admitted arrays/history give identical logits/masks/labels under fixed sampler state despite hidden-state changes
Separate diagnostic artifact schema; loader rejects oracle/full-state label provenance
Actor/value/auxiliary-target provenance and pixel/history alignment review
provenance.history: Declare finite causal history, sampling cadence, masks and padding; align with the student's available frames/actions. Do not silently add privileged or indefinite recurrent memory.
provenance.snapshot: Opaque simulator/RNG state may be stored/restored for continuity and diagnostics. Policy, labeler and shield cannot read it. Start-state prioritization does not authorize oracle supervision.

standing_metrics.caveats: 256-game monitoring panels have only64 observations per tail and are diagnostic. Noise proxies do not replace evaluation on an actual student's state distribution or establish calibrated probabilities.
standing_metrics.contrasts: Noise-minus-clean Q1/Mean and normalized retention; sort each condition separately before tail means. Shared-game-seed bootstrap2000 draws across every model/condition; actual fractions and per-model/per-training-replica results retained.
standing_metrics.scope: These are standing endpoint/entry/monitor/final evaluation panels; numerical optimization telemetry remains every update. No noise-driven LR/entropy/controller adjustment during the long run.
standing_metrics.switches: Log intended policy-action, post-shield selected-action, and raw-frame executed-action switches separately. Numerator/denominator only within live episodes; carry across rollouts, exclude resets and neutral initialization. Report decision-rate and per1000-raw-frame measures; no queue boundary counted twice.

teacher_goal: Maximize teacher quality under the admitted short-history observation boundary, including robustness and useful soft labels for a future vision student.
